title: The only thing that matters in losing weight
body:
The most important thing to know about losing weight is:

Again, that's...

The reason I put it twice is because all diets, methods, gimmicks revolve around this 1 principle

Literally... every single method you hear about revolves around this one principle

A diet will either cut calories, or cause you to eat less calories by killing your hunger

And just like your thoughts when it comes to your mindset, the only thing you have 100% control over when it comes to your weight is the amount of Calories you take in

Here's how it works:
           If you eat more than you burn, you will be on what's called a 'caloric surplus' and you will gain weight
           If you eat the same as you burn, you will be on what's called a 'maintenance' level of calories and you  will maintain weight.
           If you eat less than you burn, you will be on what's called a 'caloric deficit' and you will lose weight

You might be thinking now that you can just workout more, and burn a bunch more calories OUT - but it doesn't work that way. This will be explained in the next section.

First, I want to drive home that Calories IN always come first. Regardless of the 'diet' or 'method'...

Those who get on keto, cut carbs

In doing so, they get less calories in, and inadvertently lose weight

Those who go vegan, they cut meats

In doing so, they get less calories in, and inadvertently lose weight

Those who eat carnivore, cut carbs & grains

In doing so, they get less calories in, and inadvertently lose weight

The problem with those diets is that they rely on you cutting entire food groups out of your life

And that makes them unsustainable for the long term

How often have you seen someone get on Keto, lose 10-15 lbs, and gain it all back?

The best diet is always the one you can stick to for life

And the good news is that you can eat whatever you want... as long as you eat:

1.) The right amount of calories for your goals - your calorie level will be shown in your training app once you complete this meal plan

2.) Enough protein - your protein requirements will also be shown in your training app

3.) Mainly real food - no processed ingredients or fake foods

This does not mean you need to actually track how many calories you 'burn' every day...

"}" data-trix-content-type="undefined" class="attachment attachment--content">

As I mention in the video above, managing your 'Calories IN' is the only thing you have 100% control over. And most estimates of how many calories you actually burned throughout the whole day are inaccurate.

Your body usually ends up burning a steady amount of calories every day, and if that number changes, it will change very slowly.

That's why focusing primarily on your Calories IN is the best way to ensure your deficit is 'just right'

If it's too small, your weight loss will go too slow and you'll lose motivation

If it's too big, your body will go into 'survival mode' and shut down your 'non-essential functions'

'Non-essential functions' are things that don't keep you alive, like:

- Hair growth

- Skin health

- Mood

- Mental Clarity

- Energy Levels

- Body Temperature

More importantly, if your deficit is too big - your hunger and cravings will get out of control

And one way to keep cravings at bay when on a deficit… is eating enough protein

That’s what we’re going to cover in next week's Strong Body Wednesday, answer the questions below and I'll talk to you soon!

title: Why and How to drink more water
body:
If you want to lose weight...

You will need to be on a caloric deficit

That is basically all you need to know when it comes to losing weight

BUT

Being on a caloric deficit means your feeding your body less than it 'needs'

And in return, your body will produce cravings and hunger

If these cravings / hungers get too big, you will cave in

And you will eat too many calories

One of the easiest ways of reducing your cravings and hunger, is to simply drink water

Drinking water will reduce your hunger

Along with dozens of other benefits

But honestly, from what I'm seeing, NOBODY IN AMERICA drinks enough water

Everyone is walking around with huge stomachs, getting botox to fix their face, and wearing the cutest outfits that still come in their size

All while not even drinking enough water

If you don't drink enough water, nothing will work

You will NEVER lose weight if you don't drink enough water

Your brothers and sisters, nieces and nephews will say diabetes 'runs in the family'

But it's likely nobody even walks in your family because they're all dehydrated

Taken one step further...

You will probably die a slow and painful death if you don't drink enough water

And this is harsh...

But your kids will be crying at your deathbed, wondering why you had to leave earth so soon

All because you were too lazy to drink enough water

It's that important

Everyone plays it off like it's nothing, and I'm the crazy one

But have you looked around lately?

Everybody's fat

Yet everyone assumes drinking water is too 'simple' of a solution

Surely 'drinking water' can't be the secret to losing weight?

It is

It's the very first step, where everything starts

If you don't drink enough water - your life will suck (and you'll have bad breath)

Here's a video I made for you on how to drink more water

title: How much protein do you need to get lean?
body:
Weight loss is great

But, 'weight' can be fat, muscle, water, inflammation...

And if you're going to lose weight, it's FAT that you want to lose

If you don't get enough protein in - your 'weight loss' will mostly be muscle

That's why out of the 3 'macros', protein is the most important when it comes to getting strong & sculpted

You know about calories right?

Now it's time you learn about 'macros'...

Every calorie can be 1 of 3 'macros'

These macros are:

- Carbohydrates (carbs)

- Proteins

- Fats

Carbs give you energy & fiber

Proteins repair your muscle and boost your immune system

And Fats regulate your hormones & provide vitamins

Out of the 3 macros above, protein is the only one that kills cravings

And eating protein will always make you more 'full' than eating carbs or fats...

And how do you lose weight? (or, how do you lose fat?)

You lose fat by eating a 'caloric deficit'

By eating less than you 'need'

When you are not getting what you 'need', it's likely you will get hungry. And many times get uncontrollable cravings that cause you to act irrational and give in to temptations.

Protein is the ultimate antidote to this

And it helps you build muscle - which in turn helps you burn even more calories while at rest

How much protein should you take?

As a good rule of thumb, shoot for 1 gram of protein per pound of bodyweight that you want to weigh

So if you're currently 180, but want to weigh 140 - then eat 140 grams of protein... every day

That's a lot easier said than done

But as with everything else that's easier said than done, the best way to do it is by starting off strong

So have your first meal be 30-40 grams of protein right away

With that said, can you just eat any protein?

Well, yes...

But if all you do is eat junk food, you’ll get zero nutrients or vitamins in. Here's a quick video on this:

"}" data-trix-content-type="undefined" class="attachment attachment--content">

You'll have no energy, and you’ll be a lot more hungry. And this makes it a struggle to stick to your calories

Not to mention, your gut microbiome will not be getting the nutrients it needs to thrive

If there’s one thing you need to know about health - it's that all your health starts in your stomach

Keeping a healthy digestion is paramount to living a long healthy life

That’s why I'm about to list the 14 best foods you can eat, but just fyi - you don't need to memorize them.

I do however want you to read them, because I want you to see how real food is always the answer:

Red Meat / Steak
Provides Iron, Vitamin B12, Zinc, Selenium

Egg Yolks
Provides Vitamin A, B5, B12, Folate, Phosphorous, K2, Choline, Biotin, along with every vitamin you need except for Vitamin C (eggs also give you Cysteine, which helps you metabolize Glutathione - the mother of all antioxidants). And the Choline optimizes your Kidney function, and the Biotin keeps your skin/hair/nails on point (especially on a caloric deficit)

Potatoes
One of the most 'filling' foods in the world, and they provide 2x the amount of Potassium than Bananas do. Potassium helps muscles contract, and regulates fluid and mineral balances. It prevents cramping, constipation, heart arrhythmia, and helps maintain normal blood pressure by limiting the effects of sodium

Cranberry Juice
Provides iodine which optimizes thyroid, metabolism, immune system, and digestion. Iodine also flushes out toxins from your thyroid (which might cause nausea at first)

Bone Broth/Stock
Provides collagen, aids in digestion, and improves gut health

Oranges
Fruit gives energy, increases your body temperature, improves your satiety, and stimulates your liver to increase your metabolism. As long as your sugars are coming from fruit, you will give yourself a second source of energy. Furthermore, oranges provide Naringin, an enzyme that extends free testosterone

Bell Peppers
Provide 3x the Vitamin C as Citrus Fruits, which improve your immune system

Carrots
Provide fiber that shuttles toxins out of your liver

Sodium
Keeps you hydrated, boosts your metabolism, and improves recovery

Yogurt
The probiotics improve gut health

Mahi Mahi, Salmon, Grass-Fed Beef
Provides Omega 3’s, which fight inflammation, improve muscle recovery, and prevent heart disease

Spinach, Potatoes, Yogurt, Beef, Fruit
Provide Potassium (see Potatoes for benefits)

Yogurt, Cheddar Cheese
Provide Calcium, which enhances nerve 'signaling' (the firing of muscles)

Spinach, Almonds, Yogurt
Provide Magnesium, which stimulates your metabolism, optimizes your testosterone, and provides muscular recovery from strenuous workouts

body:
Your subconscious mind will 'adapt' to how you eat

What I mean is...

If you eat standing up, scarfing your food down as fast as possible - your body and mind will 'assume' that food is not really a priority for you

And you will continue to act in accordance with that belief

"Food is not important enough to sit down for, therefore the types of foods I eat don't matter anyway"

You would put more effort into what goes into that meal

And...

An added benefit to sitting down for each meal will have you chew your food more thoroughly.

Which in turn improves digestion and nutrient absorption.

title: Luck doesn't exist
body:
"When faith is mixed with thought, your subconscious mind will translate it into its spiritual equivalent, which is infinite intelligence" - Napoleon Hill

The above quote sums up how nobody is every doomed to bad luck

In fact, from now on I want you to live in a world where luck does not even exist

Here's how this works:

You know how a submarine has a periscope?

The entire submarine is under water, and ONE person can look through the periscope

That ONE person will have the power to tell everyone aboard the submarine what's happening above sea level

Whatever orders that ONE person gives, the entire submarine will follow instantly

All the crew aboard blindly trust this ONE person

This ONE person is you and your conscious thinking

And the entire submarine is your subconscious mind

Whatever you decide to think, your subconscious will act on

Whether it's positive or negative...

Your subconscious mind will move on whatever thoughts you feed it

So...

You want to get lucky?

You want the number on the scale to go down?

Your business to thrive?

Relationships to flourish?

Then feed yourself positive thoughts

It's the only way you will voluntarily develop good faith (aka, a strong subconscious mind),

Nobody is doomed to bad luck

Because whatever is picked up by your subconscious mind will be translated into its physical equivalent.

Now you're probably thinking: "where do I start with this?", "what thoughts should I think then?"

Start with these 5...

Repeat these daily to become self-reliant, successful, and finally lose some serious weight and keep it off:

1. I know I have the ability to get in shape. Therefore I demand from myself persistent continuous action and I promise to do just that.

2. I realize that thoughts become things. Therefore I will concentrate daily on who I want to become and exactly who/what I want to have in my life.

3. I have clearly written down my goals and I will never stop trying until I have developed sufficient self-confidence for their attainment.

4. I will concentrate on my desire until it becomes a burning obsession. And I will do this by reading my goals out loud daily and back them with emotion.

5. I understand that I become who I surround myself with. Therefore I will succeed by attracting to myself the forces which I choose to use and the cooperation of other people. I will eliminate hatred, envy, jealousy, selfishness and cynicism by developing love for all. Because I know that a negative attitude towards others can never bring me success. I will cause others to believe in me because I believe in them (and in myself).

Remember - luck doesn't exist

Luck is merely a word used by those who don't understand the power of their very own thoughts.

Everything you want is right within your grasp.

Your submarine crew is ready and eagerly waiting for your instructions - what are you going to tell them?

title: Dealing with setbacks
body:
As you set out to lose weight, you will encounter setbacks

We all go through this

Some weeks you'll do everything perfect and the scale won't move

Other weeks you'll completely fall of the wagon and mess up on your food

When this happens, it's important not to react - but instead, to respond.

And the difference is in how you respond...

Especially when things get tough. You might start thinking like a failure...

Like you were never meant to succeed anyway.

But, remember -> Every failure brings with it the seed of an equivalent success.

When your plans fail, it does not mean failure.

It means you need to build stronger plans.

Because a quitter never wins, and a winner never quits.

Whenever you face adversity, prove to yourself that your philosophy can take care of the situation of failure.

For defeat is never failure. No circumstance is ever failure until it is accepted by the individual as such.

You can always profit through adversity, by staying at it.

Where everyone else would give up, you reinvent yourself and you keep going.

That's how winning is done.

title: Going the Extra Mile
body:
There is one major requirement for successfully losing weight that you will never hear in popular media or advertisements

Even those who lost weight and kept it off will not tell you, because for them it probably comes natural

This one requirement is going the extra mile

Going the extra mile is when you're doing more than what is asked, doing more than what is asked all the time, and doing more than what is asked, all the time, with a pleasant attitude.

And it is the ONLY way you can make life pay you whatever you want

But it's never talked about

Because it's hard to do, and even harder to sell

But have you ever seen someone do good at first...

Then next year they do better?

And years later you find out they've been doing better every single year, constantly improving?

It's because they kept going the extra mile, and in doing so they increased the returns that gave them above-average results

In other words, the longer you go the extra mile - the bigger your returns get

Like magic, it compounds over time

Going the extra mile for a couple days does nothing.

Doing it for months, years - will change your life. Add to the fact that you will start getting ‘lucky breaks’.

And... your ‘doing extra’ with a pleasing attitude will improve your personality and improve your imagination.

This is because you’re constantly seeking new and better ways to do things.

Lastly, going the extra mile kills procrastination (which is the #1 cause of failure)

In case you're not convinced just yet, here are 5 benefits of going the extra mile:

1. You stand out from most - for most don't even go the first mile. It shows your trainer/coach that you're in this to win it. And your trainer/coach will probably take you very serious.

2. It leads to a mental growth and physical perfection throughout all aspects of your life.

3. It protects you against adversity. Because it develops self reliance.

4. It leads to the development of a positive and pleasing personal attitude.

5. It is the only justifiable reason to ask for favors from others.

Don't be like everyone else - complaining that things are hard

Take on the work, and do more than what's expected of you

Within no time you'll be miles further than you've ever been in your life.

title: Fear & Doubt
body:
As mentioned in your earlier STRONG MIND emails, you and I have 100% control over just 1 thing in our life...

Our own mindset.

We all know it

But most people don’t realize the power this gives us - as most people still live in fear and doubt

When you live in fear and doubt, it simply means you dwell on the things you do NOT want in your life

How do you fix this?

Simple, you use applied faith, take possession of your mind, and think of the things you DO want in life.

You will always attract what you think and believe.

So choose wisely.

The one thing that separates successful people from those who live in fear and doubt is that the successful have a capacity for belief

Failures see the hole in the donut

Successful people see the donut around the hole

Success requires belief, and the first 'thing' to believe in is yourself.

Here are 5 steps to strengthen your applied faith:

-1- Know what you want and believe you will get it

-2- Express gratitude many times, every day for that which you want - even BEFORE you actually get it. All possession starts in the mind.

-3- Be ready to act immediately on 'gut feelings'

-4- When overtaken by defeat, remember that your faith will be tested many times before you get what you want

-5- Possess a burning desire for what you want

With 100% control over what you put in your mind, you can literally attract whichever you demand in life.

Remember, faith is something you already have. However if you’re like most people, you’re using it wrong by focusing on what you do not want.

Direct all your thoughts towards what you want

You'll be amazed by how your life will change

title: Accurate Thinking
body:
Remember the SMF email from a couple weeks ago that said procrastination is our main cause of failure?

Unfortunately, many people procrastinate because they simply can't choose...

They can't choose from all the diets, weight loss solution, or myths and fads that are floating around these days

It's very easy nowadays to get analysis-paralysis.

Or in other words, decision-fatigue...

Where you simply can't commit to deciding from the myriad of options presented to you.

This is where accurate thinking comes in

Accurate thinking helps you separate important facts from unimportant facts

(And just so you know, most facts you encounter will be unimportant)

Important facts are any facts that help you attain your major purpose in life.

All other facts are unimportant.

The same thing goes for opinions...

Most opinions are worthless as they are based on bias, prejudice, intolerance, hearsay evidence, and ignorance.

When you practice accurate thinking, you'll become skilled at picking out the important facts and ignoring all others.

Here are 4 tips to get better at this:

1. Never accept opinions as facts until you learn their sources

2. Free advice generally is worth exactly what it costs

3. Alert yourself immediately when you hear someone speak of something or someone negatively. Usually what you are hearing is biased.

4. Believing only what you wish to believe will condemn you to eternal failure and defeat

The biggest tragedy you can experience in your life is to be indifferent and not learn how to think accurately.

Try this out for yourself, and write down all important and unimportant facts you dealt with yesterday.

You might be surprised how little of them were crucial to your major purpose in life...

title: Learning from Adversity
body:
When you're trying to lose weight, it's not IF you will experience setbacks. It's WHEN.

We all run into roadblocks. In all aspects of life.

And it’s how you bounce back from them that matters.

Setbacks are nature's way of ‘teaching’ you how to take control over your own mind.

Too often we rely on our physical labor to do all the work

But that will only get you so far.

It is not until we take 100% control over our mind that we achieve extraordinary results.

Only then can you see that every set back brings with it the seed of an equivalent benefit.

Look back into your own negative experiences, did you ever have a benefit come from it?

Oftentimes, your greatest blessings will come from your greatest adversities.

Your adversity is never a 'failure'...

In fact, nothing can ever be called a failure until it is recognized by the individual as such.

Take full possession of your own mind and you will live up to your true potential.

title: Nostalgia is a liar (invest in this instead)
body:
My Mom was diagnosed with stage 4c Ovarian cancer in late 2010

Of course, your whole life turns upside down (I never knew my Dad, and I'm an 'only child')

My Mom thought she would 'last' for perhaps a year.

So she started going to her favorite place (Vegas) almost every other week.

She knew how to win $700 out of penny machines

And she would always draw crowds

After a year, she 'calmed down' a little and prepared to live as long of a life as comfortably possible.

All the while going on cruises, playing Bingo (winning), going out to eat daily, staying active

I usually had to make appts to see her

But one place I always made sure to see her was at chemo appointments

The reality is that these chemo sessions were never 'fun'

If anyone needs perspective on life, visit a cancer ward and you'll see.

Some people were alone, while others were there one week and forever gone the next

However...

When I think back of her chemo appts, all I remember is happiness

The horrible traffic on the 101, her anxiety over what the doctor was going to say next, the uncertain emotions - I don't remember any of that.

All I remember are the little walks we made in the Hospital garden

Or times we just laughed for no good reason

At first I thought "this is not right"

But then I read the book 'Essentialism' by Greg McKeown. And it states:

Your memories only get better with time. And most negative aspects erode over time.

Your memories get more 'pure' every year, until you end up with a highlight reel of all the best moments you shared.

Which brings me to the point of this story - your best investment will always be the experience itself

It's not the 'getting there', because odds are - you'll never get there

3 steps to put this into action right now:

-1- Set goals you can not achieve in your lifetime

And don't set time limits for these goals. They should transcend time.

-2- Hustle smart to hit these goals

But live in the moment at all times.

-3- Never take anything for granted

You might be hurting right now, overwhelmed, and everything is chaos.

But all your anguish will erode

And it'll all seem trivial in no time.

Feeling overwhelmed means you're growing. And success only happens in chaos.

So make those memories now

Do more

Be better.

It always pays off in the end.

title: Fear kills everything you ever wanted
body:
FEAR literally ruins our lives

It causes us to be 'too busy'

(because we fear losing what we've built)

it causes us to procrastinate

(because what if we mess up?)

And it causes us to live in mediocrity, especially after we've had some success

(because every time we climb, it's a higher fall if we slip)

The irony is, the more fear you have of messing up, the more likely it is that you'll mess up.

Fear is a 'self-fulfilling prophecy'

And the answer is... love

I know this sounds John-Lennon-like, but...

If you focus on the love of you 'building it' over the fear of you 'losing it', you will always come out ahead

Love your struggles (they'll make you appreciate your resilience in pushing through)

Love your challenges (they make you stronger)

Love your competition (they force you to be better)

Love your vampires (they reveal how positive you are in contrast)

So... what does this have to do with you losing fat?

Well, if you start loving the foods you eat

The water you drink

And the exercise you do

Then you'll find way more meaning in all of it.

There is grace and harmony in the most basic things in life

If you see these things (that others can't see), then your world will be so much better than some dark place filled with fear.

title: Challenge yourself... or be miserable
body:
You'll never be the best

Somewhere... in some underground cave

There is someone training harder and eating better than you

But that's alright

Because even though you'll never beat everyone - your life will be 10x happier if you strive to be the best

Whether you strive to be the best, or 'good enough', it takes the same amount of effort

In 'trying' to be the best, you will:

- become better than anyone thought you would

- have to fail often

Any time you get beat down - you will have to go back, reinvent yourself, figure out a better way of doing it, and attack again

Once you win that challenge, the next one awaits

And every time you win a challenge, you get blessed with more skill, power, and competence

And every single challenge only gets BIGGER

The reason so many are miserable is because they avoid challenges

They run, watch the news, and plug their umbilical cord into some grey-haired authority-type figure that tells them to 'stay safe' and live in fear

Sadly, the only 'challenge' most people will accept in their life is to post a pic of how they were 10 years ago

No challenges = no accomplishment = no fulfillment

And if you never challenge yourself, our society is designed to suck you into the downward spiral of addiction, disease, diabetes, and divorce.

Until you end up with no spine and accept whatever the government recommends

Challenges are good

They keep you coming back

And they never stop

Which means your potential is endless

The more challenges you take on, the more awesome you become

And the more 'meaningful' your life becomes

Strive to be the best in everything you do

The world needs more strong people to set the tone

That can be you

title: Give it all away
body:
When I was a rookie trainer at a big gym back in 2007, my boss always told me:

"You have to take them to school with you, take them to SCHOOL with you!"

Meaning, when I took on a client - not just put them through the motions.

But teach them WHY I was telling them what to eat, and the reason behind how I was training them.

This way it would stick with them for life

(and they would make it a lifestyle change)

Since then, it's been one of things in which my coaching has separated itself from the rest

I give it 'all away'

And you should too

Because when one teaches, two learn.

The teacher benefits just as greatly from teaching as the student does from being taught

Because when you teach, you ingrain it into your head

And when you teach, you are telling others what to do

You will then undoubtedly want to live up to your words, and practice what you preach

So take in everything you're learning

And share it with your surroundings and loved ones

It's a sure-fire way to become that better role model you've always wanted to be

title: Does it really matter?
body:
When my business took off, I started getting into cars

I bought an M3, then muscle cars, track cars, eventually leading to Aston Martins and other exotics.

As I was getting more into it - I started becoming what others would call a 'purist'

Which means, I wanted my car to be PERFECT.

The perfect wheels, best engine, suspension, the best exhaust, paint protection, the right seats, etc, etc.

Looking back now - almost all the things I looked for were so trivial, they didn't matter at all.

Because...

I actually enjoyed the cheaper cars way more than the Aston Martins

(they gave me more 'smiles per miles')

Moral of the story - minutia never matters

Like Dan Pena says:

"Hardly anything you'll ever do is a matter of life or death - in the cosmos of time, any decision you make is merely a fart in the wind"

To take this one step further, the top 5 regrets of those on their deathbed are:

- how they wish they lived a life true to themselves (and now the life that others expected of them)

- how they wish they hadn't worked so hard (at the things they didn't love)

- how they wish they had the courage to express their feelings

- how they wish they stayed in touch with their friends

- how they wish they had let themselves be happier

Of the above points, nobody mentions anything about impressing others.

Or being good-looking.

Not even of having a 6-pack =)

Think big picture, and see the love and beauty in the smallest details. It makes life so much more enjoyable.

title: Your willpower is fine, it's your environment that's the issue...
body:
Social media will show you fit people doing workouts you can only dream of

And others eating whatever they want while staying lean

If you let this inundate you, it's easy to think you're not 'cut out for it'

Or you might start doubting your own willpower

If this is you, stop this immediately

From my experience training clients in-person and online, willpower is rarely the issue

What's much more precarious is your environment

Your environment is what's serving you all these images in the first place

Get your environment under control and your life will be solid

Here's how...

First, recognize you have 3 'types' pf environment:

1... your physical environment

2... your social environment

3... your digital environment

Physical is what's in your kitchen, your car, your workspace, etc

Social is who you spend time with

(and what you do when with them...)

Digital is the apps on your phone and the social media you follow

The DIGITAL is the type of environment that kills dreams every day

Check your digital environment and filter it out

When working, put your phone in another room

Don't take your phone to the restroom with you

And unfollow anyone who isn't doing 10x better than you

Less is more, and the impact your social media has on your results can not be underestimated

"When you try to turn the wheels of a car, what's easier?..."

body:

Or in other words, you need to know:

Follow these 6 steps for you to set yourself up for success:

title: How to get better sleep (so you can get lean faster)
body:
Any time I have a client who is doing everything right, but not losing weight, it's their sleep

Meaning, they are:

- drinking a gallon of water
- hitting their calories 7 days a week
- eating enough protein
- getting 10,000 steps a day
- exercising 2-3x week

... the ONLY aspect that can still prevent you from losing weight, is not getting enough sleep

You might think you're 'building muscle' in the gym

Or that you're burning fat doing cardio

But building muscle and burning fat ONLY happens when you're asleep

Your body needs to be 'shut off' for that to happen

And I see it countless times where women put in hard work in the gym & kitchen

... only to get frustrated by their lack of progress because they simply don't sleep enough

Here's a video I made for you on this

In it I'll tell you how many hours you should aim for

Along with some tips on achieving deeper sleep (which promotes better recovery)

title: How much caffeine should you have every day?
body:
Caffeine is kind of a weird subject

It has massive benefits (kills hunger, provides energy, warms up your joints pre-workouts)

But it can also mess with your sleep, stress, hormones, and mood

So I personally don't take more than 200 mg per day

But, I also have clients born in El Salvador who have been drinking coffee since they were little kids (and their parents still live there happily and healthy at age 90+)

So is caffeine evil?

Claro que no

But I do think in our high-paced American lifestyle - it's wise to moderate it

Here are some of the things I tell my clients:

--- Never take caffeine within 90 min upon waking

(this is when your body produces its' cortisol - aka, natural energy, if you take caffeine during this time you will diminish your natural energy and crash later in the day)

--- Stop taking caffeine 10 hours pre-bedtime

(so you fall into a deeper sleep more easily)

--- Drink your coffee black

(or put cinnamon in it if you're fasting - and protein powder if you're in your eating window)

--- Your pre-workout shouldn't have a ton of ingredients

(just caffeine and some amino acids, and stay away from those with words such as 'explode', 'beast', and 'veins' in the title)

--- Max out your total caffeine intake to 300-400 mg per day

(combined over 2-4 servings throughout the day)

--- Put L-Theanine in your coffee or pre-workout

(this will 'prolong' the effects of your caffeine, so you end up needing less)

title: 4 Things you need to know about Calories
body:

title: Self-Discipline
body:
Discipline = choosing what you want most over what you want now.

And it's one of the major components on your road to permanent weight loss

I think too often we relate the term 'discipline' to restrictive diets'

But as you've seen in the meal plan I've given you, the only 2 foods you should really cut are processed foods and excess sugars.

Even then, you still need to practice self-discipline to enforce your positive habits.

Here are the 6 biggest things you must exercise self-discipline over:

1. Your tongue
Think first, then speak only when you’re sure it will benefit all parties involved.

2. The tendency to strike back
What you do upon others, you are doing upon yourself. Your every thought and act comes back to you exactly how you give it.

3. Your emotions
In particular those of love, hate, fear, and sex.

4. Your mental attitude
A bad one will destroy all opportunities and give you bad health

5. Your stomach
Sticking to the 55 best foods from your meal plan

6. Religion and Politics
You will always encounter varying beliefs. Lean to live and let live to be prosperous.

Nobody becomes wise or finds happiness without self-discipline.

Self-discipline will unlock your ‘other self’, that winner inside you that does not become influences by failure and defeat.

Put short, self-discipline is how you think your own thoughts, live your own life as you wish to live it, and remain forever free from the evils of fear and limitations.

title: You need more potassium (here's how)
body:
For lack of better words, Potassium is what gives your muscles 'electricity'

Have you ever worked out one day, where you felt amazing?

You were (for lack of better words), basically going like BAM BAM

Then next week you do that same workout, but this time you feel totally blah?

The issue might very well be that you were lacking potassium in that blah workout of yours.

Potassium is the 'primary intracellular electrolyte', and it is one of the most under-consumed in the American Diet.

And aside from giving you that explosive energy, potassium also:

- maintains fluid and electrolyte balance in your body (less bloating)
- lowers your blood pressure and water retention
- helps prevent heart arrhythmia (irregular heart beat)
- prevents cramping
- fights arthritis
- is just overall good for your immune system and overall health

Everyone needs to hit 4,700 mg every day.

And every day you start at zero.

One of the best ways to get it in is through red meat (preferably grass-fed)

For instance, lean ground beef will give you 100 mg per ounce

Bison gives you 87 mg per ounce

And top sirloin will give you 175 mg per ounce

Another great way of getting your potassium in is through potatoes (all kinds - usually 900 mg for a medium potato).

Along with:

- Avocado (975 mg each)
- Orange Juice (500 mg per cup)
- Spinach (1,500 mg for every 10 oz)
- Ribeye (450 mg for 6 oz)
- Dried Apricot or Bananas (1,500 mg per cup)
- Salmon (700 mg for every 6 oz)
- Yogurt (400 mg per cup)
- Sun Dried tomatoes (1700 mg per cup)

Trust me, start focusing on hitting that magic 4,700 mg number

Hit it for 7 days in a row... then message me on how your workouts have been

I guarantee you'll be feeling amazing

Stay tuned for your Strong Mind Friday email,
Michael

title: How to snap out of being sad
body:
Some of my friends are millionaires, and they started their business at the same time as me

I would never ask this question (because I hear it in fitness all the time)

But if I were to ask them the question: "What is your secret?"

They would say the exact same thing I tell my clients:

"There is none"

...and, that:

"Everyone puts their pants on one leg at a time"

I.e. everyone is human

And everyone goes through dark places at times

It's normal

I've found however that you can 'snap out' of these dark places by asking yourself some deep questions.

Namely:

-1- IS THIS IN MY CONTROL?

Never spend emotional energy on things you can't control

(especially the news)

If you do have control over it, then change it to your liking

-2- IS THIS JUST ANOTHER STORY I'M TELLING MYSELF?

Your feelings might tell you one thing

And it's easy to rationalize those feelings by making up a story on why you're feeling them

But true power will come from finding the truth of why you're feeling that way

Like Ben Shapiro says - "facts don't care about your feelings"

Creating stories that keep you stuck will only cause unnecessary suffering

Tell yourself another story, and you'll find yourself out of that dark place in days

title: All of the 'Best Digesting Foods' you should prioritize in your meals.
body:
Eating good food is one thing, being able to digest it is another.

Here's a list with all the best digesting foods you can eat.

Vegetables: Eggplant, green beans, carrots, cucumbers, lettuce, potatoes, zucchini, bell peppers, bok choy, celery, chives, kale, pumpkin, radishes, spinach, tomatoes, winter squash, and yams

Fruits: Cantaloupe, kiwi, mandarin, orange, pineapple, grapes, strawberries, blueberries

Dairy and alternatives: Almond milk, brie cheese, feta cheese, hard cheeses, lactose-free milk, oat milk, rice milk, soy milk, lactose-free yogurt, gelati, and sorbet

Proteins: Eggs, firm tofu, plain cooked meats/poultry/seafood, tempeh, chicken, beef, turkey, cold cuts, lamb

Cereals, grains, and breads: Corn flakes, oats, quinoa/rice/corn pasta, sourdough spelt bread, gluten free bread or cereal products, 100% spelt bread, rice, polenta

Sugars and sweeteners: Dark chocolate, maple syrup, rice malt syrup, table sugar

Nuts and seeds: Macadamias, peanuts, pumpkin seeds, walnuts

NOTE: You do not need to swap out all foods that are not on this list immediately. Merely use this as advice, especially if you 'feel' like certain foods don't sit well with you. Swap them out for foods on this list and see how you do with them.

title: Your standards are as important as your goals
body:
By now you know habits are everything

And by now I'm hoping you built yourself some 'non-negotiables'

(standards you hold yourself up to every day)

Like clean food, adequate water intake, exercise, going for walks, and living in abundance

Focus on all the above and your goals will automatically 'fall into place'

So in case you're not doing this yet

(or you fell off)

Here's a basic reminder

> Plan your day in advance

Think about the most critical actions you must do tomorrow

They don't even have to be big. They can be small standards that are non-negotiable to you.

Progress doesn't come from doing big things once in a while

It comes from consistently doing obvious things for uncommonly long periods of time

(...all without convincing yourself you're smarter than you really are)

This is why it's so important to have accountability in your life

Your brain is simply too powerful in making excuses

And it LOVES justifying why you don't have what you want

Promises made to yourself are always weaker than promises made to others

This is where your coach comes in

Someone who won't buy your cheap excuses and tell you the truth.

The higher you want to go in your life, the more fulfillment you seek...

... the more you need a coach

Everyone needs someone to tell them the truth, so they can consistently live up to their high standards

title: "Why am I not losing weight anymore?"
body:
If you set out to lose weight, set goals, you start eating better, you start exercising…

And you go hard for a couple weeks...

And the scale hasn’t moved...?

THIS

... is when the average person (with no ‘reason why’) will stop (and try again next year)

This is often also where people will get back on their prescription meds (and live a downward spiraling life)

If you're doing everything right, but not losing weight, the solution is way more simple than you think

Here's a quick video with 3 things to go over first

In this video you'll see 3 'questions' you have to ask yourself

Pass these 3 questions, and you can change your approach

But 99% of the time, these 3 questions will give you the clarity you need to keep going (and eventually hit your goal weight with ease).
